en.title: Minimum Initial Funds to Produce All Products
en.description:
Before starting each product, cash must be at least its worst-case cost w, but only its expected cost e is actually deducted. Production can be arranged in any order; find the minimum initial cash needed to complete all products.

This site independently prepared the standard I/O and the solution; bounds supplemented where the source lacks them and corrections to examples are stated explicitly in the specification.
en.input: The first line contains n, followed by n lines of w e. Complete original bounds: 1≤n≤100000, 1≤e≤w≤100000. Output an exact integer, not limited to 32 bits by the int in the original example signature.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 5; 10; 1. Verified by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Sort by w−e from largest to smallest, maintain the amount spent so far, and take the maximum of spent+w as the answer.
